style.vernacular: Hot-humid sprawling metropolis of painted-concrete hollow-block buildings: low-rise cream, grey and pastel houses and shops with corrugated galvanised roofs, narrow multi-storey commercial strips with bright signage, glass-and-concrete towers in Makati, Ortigas and Bonifacio Global City, and boxy mall blocks in cream and white. Heritage core of Spanish-era brick and stone baroque churches and American-era neoclassical civic buildings; Brutalist Marcos-era government blocks. Rain trees, palms and heavy overhead wiring.
style.ornament: Spanish-era earthquake-baroque churches with thick buttresses, pilasters, plastered cornices and a detached or attached belfry; bahay na bato timber upper floors with capiz-shell sliding windows and balustrades; American-era neoclassical civic buildings with columns and pediments; Marcos-era Brutalist concrete; bright jeepney and shop-sign colours.
